scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: Tara wants help organising the Connection Lab’s nature cards. Neel suggests using AI for every job, including adding two supply counts. Their teacher asks them to describe the job first: what result is needed, and how would they recognise useful help?
scenes.speech: Tara wants help organising the Connection Lab’s nature cards. Neel suggests using A I for every job, including adding two supply counts. Their teacher asks them to describe the job first: what result is needed, and how would they recognise useful help?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: Adding exact counts follows a fixed arithmetic rule. Sorting varied drawings might use patterns learned from labelled examples, but that model could make mistakes. A person sorting cards manually is another method. Calling a tool intelligent does not establish that it suits the job.
scenes.speech: Adding exact counts follows a fixed arithmetic rule. Sorting varied drawings might use patterns learned from labelled examples, but that model could make mistakes. A person sorting cards manually is another method. Calling a tool intelligent does not establish that it suits the job.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: The team compares methods on the same fictional cards and records correct placements and time taken. It includes the simple manual method as a baseline. A complicated helper earns its place only if the measured benefit justifies its mistakes, effort and need for human review.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: The inputs are known numbers and the required output is their exact sum. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.speech: The inputs are known numbers and the required output is their exact sum. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: Use the fixed addition rule. A learned guess adds uncertainty without helping this exact task. Compare tools against the stated need.
scenes.speech: Use the fixed addition rule. A learned guess adds uncertainty without helping this exact task. Compare tools against the stated need.
scenes.dialogue: Choose a fixed rule for an exact stated calculation.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Investigate in the lab
scenes.caption: Investigate define the job, then compare methods, then measure useful help. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
